sections.name: File setup (part 1)
sections.title: Shared identity defaults and label filling
sections.what: Sets default labels for the organization, initials, and wordmark, applies any override the page has set, saves the result for other scripts, and fills every marked element.
sections.why: Stated in the comment: the static pages have no build step, so one shared file is the only place to keep a single value.
sections.watch_out: The defaults are a role, not a person, and putting a personal name back into the page markup defeats the purpose.

sections.name: File setup: if
sections.title: Run now or wait for page load
sections.what: Runs the filling step straight away if the page is already loaded, or waits for the ready moment if it is still loading.
sections.why: Likely reason: the script sits in the page head, before the marked elements exist, so it must wait for them.

summary: Holds the single set of organization and label values for the static pages, and fills them into those pages when they load.
purpose: Stops a personal name from being typed into several pages, so branding can be changed in one place.
why: Stated in the code: the static pages have no build step, so one shared script is the only place to keep one value.
how: 1. Set default labels, which are role-based rather than personal. 2. Read any override the page has set. 3. Merge overrides over the defaults. 4. Save the result for other scripts and set a CSS variable for the wordmark. 5. Fill every element marked with an identity attribute, once the page is ready.
inputs: An optional window.BEACON_IDENTITY object set before this script runs, and elements carrying data-identity attributes.
outputs: Text in the marked elements, a CSS variable named --brand-wordmark, and the saved window.BEACON_IDENTITY object.
risks: An override set after this script loads is ignored. Empty override values silently fall back to the generic defaults.
debug: If labels show Analyst or the wrong organization, check that the override runs before this script, and check the spelling of the data-identity attribute. Check the browser console for script errors.
